en-US.description: A desktop dashboard that follows X (Twitter), Threads and Discord accounts on one screen.
en-US.longDescription:
TheySay — All the Voices on One Screen.
Stop jumping between endless browser tabs and apps. TheySay brings your favorite X (Twitter) accounts, Threads creators, and Discord channels together into a single, customizable desktop dashboard.
One screen for every account, in layouts from 1x1 to 4x4: watch real-time updates from multiple followed accounts side by side, drag and resize cards to spotlight key feeds, type any username to add accounts across X and Threads, or paste a link to follow a public or private Discord channel.
Distraction-free chat-style reading: updates appear in clean, chronological chat bubbles instead of cluttered timelines. Web links display readable page titles, images sit beside the text, and clicking a message opens the full post, quoted thread, or high-resolution media in a focused popup reader.
Built for market and tech watchers: US stock, ETF and crypto tickers such as $NVDA, $TSLA and $BTC are recognised and highlighted with customizable badge colours, and mute keywords hide unwanted topics.
Unread counters on each card and on the taskbar icon show where new posts arrived, and desktop notifications can be enabled for selected accounts only. Light and dark themes, per-platform refresh intervals, automatic updates from GitHub Releases, and JSON export and import of the whole layout are included. Your session stays on your device.
en-US.name: TheySay
en-US.releaseNotes:
TheySay v1.0.3
Multi-column desktop dashboard for monitoring Twitter / X accounts, Threads profiles, and Discord channels side by side in real time.
Features & Improvements
- Pin Post Bar Below Card Header:
  - Hover over any post bubble across Twitter / X, Threads, or Discord to reveal a Pin button (📌) alongside the external link button (↗).
  - Pin one or multiple posts into a compact, collapsible Telegram-style summary bar directly below the card header; pinned posts are removed from the chronological timeline below and restored to their original timeline position when unpinned.
  - Click any pinned row to open its full post detail popup modal, collapse/expand multiple pinned posts with one click, and automatically inherit custom chat bubble theme colors.
  - Pinned posts and collapse states persist across reloads, account switches, and Profile export/import.
- Quoted Tweet Card Click Navigation:
  - Clicking a quoted tweet card inside an embedded X / Twitter post modal now opens the quoted original post in the external browser while keeping main post text selectable without unwanted redirects.
- CI: Added macOS (macos-latest) Electron end-to-end integration test job alongside Windows and Linux.

zh-CN.description: 在同一块桌面看板上追踪 X (Twitter)、Threads 与 Discord 账号的动态。
zh-CN.longDescription:
TheySay —— 在一个界面，实时追踪所有声音。
告别在无数浏览器标签页与软件之间来回切换。TheySay 将你关注的 X (Twitter) 博主、Threads 创作者与 Discord 频道汇聚在同一块可自定义的桌面看板上。
一屏纵览多账号动态，支持 1×1 至 4×4 布局：在一个界面内同时查看多个账号的实时更新，卡片可自由拖拽与调整大小，直接输入用户名即可添加 X 或 Threads 账号，粘贴链接即可追踪任意公开或私有的 Discord 频道。
清爽的对话流阅读体验：动态以按时间排列的对话气泡呈现。网页链接自动显示文章标题，配图与文字紧凑排布；点击任意气泡即可弹出阅读卡片，查看完整长文、引用内容或高清大图。
为市场与科技追踪打造：自动识别并高亮美股、ETF 与加密货币代码（如 $NVDA、$TSLA、$BTC），配色可自定义，也可以添加屏蔽词自动过滤噪音。
每张卡片与任务栏图标都会显示未读数，可以只为重点账号开启桌面通知。同时提供浅色与深色主题、各平台独立刷新频率、基于 GitHub Releases 的自动更新，以及把整块看板布局与关注列表导出或导入为 JSON 文件。登录状态保存在本机。
